body: REVIEW UPDATE exact 2d0202b: navigation/inbound link is fixed; exact placement/run command is now explicit; program and output both have full digest assertions, and output is correctly Qualified as archived rather than a run receipt; loaded-not-found and expected-not-correct are fixed. Two blockers remain. First, the new uniform-coverage reconstruction is mathematically false. RecallSignature.leafVisitation computes each leaf as 1 - exp(-acc), then uniform is the mean. It is not total source mass divided by 71. Even using the displayed rounded masses, 0.4817/71 = 0.0067845, which rounds to 0.0068, not the printed 0.0067. Likewise 2/71 is a loose upper bound, not the exact ceiling under the nonlinear saturation, so roughly a quarter of attainable is unsupported. Remove that arithmetic and explain the exact estimand from full posterior visitation; do not reconstruct it from rounded console fields. Second, the full producer revision is now text but still has no direct producer identity link; the Evidence href points to the archived output at the docs commit. Add a direct exact-revision link or clearly state why no hosted producer link exists. The accessible derived static figure remains absent and explicitly open. All other c836 repair conditions named above are cleared by source inspection at 2d0202b.
